tasks.title: Project and Sprint Mongoose models
tasks.description: server/src/models/projectModel.ts and server/src/models/sprintModel.ts: workspace scope, nameKey unique per workspace, key generated by projectKeyFrom, sprint status enum, startedAt/completedAt/completedPoints, and the { workspace, project, startDate } index.

tasks.title: Permission-scoped project and sprint router
tasks.description: server/src/routes/projectRoutes.ts mounted at /api/workspaces/:slug/projects with protect plus one requirePermission per route, and the read-only sprint report route added to server/src/routes/workspaceRoutes.ts.

tasks.title: Project CRUD with task sync and rename cascade
tasks.description: listProjects, createProject, updateProject and deleteProject in server/src/controllers/projectController.ts, including syncProjectsFromTasks, the case-insensitive cascade to tasks, wiki pages and custom fields, and the unassigning delete.

tasks.title: Sprint create, update, start and complete handlers
tasks.description: validateCreateSprint/validateUpdateSprint/validateCompleteSprint, assertSprintDates, startSprint with the one-active-sprint rule and completeSprint computing completedPoints and moving the unfinished work with a recorded sprint change per task.

tasks.title: Task-to-sprint assignment rules
tasks.description: findOpenSprint and reconcileSprint in server/src/controllers/taskController.ts: the sprint must belong to the workspace and not be completed, the task takes the sprint's project, and a project change clears the sprint; epics are refused.

tasks.title: Sprints and Backlog tabs on the project page
tasks.description: ProjectWorkspace.tsx with the six tabs, sprint cards grouped by active/planned/completed, the move-to-sprint select, the sprint form dialog, the complete-sprint dialog and the counter that remounts the task part after a sprint change.

tasks.title: Sprint report rebuilt from the activity log
tasks.description: classifySprintScope and getSprintReport in server/src/controllers/reportController.ts: replay the sprint changes, mark carry-overs, and return the committed/added/removed/completed/notCompleted buckets with count and point totals.

tasks.title: Burndown and velocity helpers with charts
tasks.description: client/src/features/projects/lib/burndown.ts and lib/velocity.ts plus BurndownChart and VelocityChart, including the points-or-tasks unit and the ideal line.

tasks.title: Sprint report page
tasks.description: client/src/pages/SprintReportPage.tsx with the five summary cards, the burndown built from scopeTasksOf(report), the delivered percentage and the bucket tables.

tasks.title: Roadmap helpers
tasks.description: client/src/features/planning/lib/roadmap.ts: buildRoadmap grouping epics per active project, health and rolled-up spans, buildAxis with month/week ticks, placeSpan, sprintBands, releaseMarkers and the describe* text alternatives.

tasks.title: Roadmap page with zoom, filters and epic list
tasks.description: client/src/pages/RoadmapPage.tsx with the project filter, month/week segmentation, the measured timeline width feeding the axis, the legend, the desktop timeline and the narrow-screen list.

tasks.title: Workload aggregation and capacity storage
tasks.description: client/src/features/planning/lib/workload.ts (tasksInScope, aggregateWorkload, defaults, describeLoad) and lib/capacity.ts (parseCapacity, loadCapacity, saveCapacity under taskman.workload.capacity.<slug>).

tasks.title: Workload page with scope switch and capacity control
tasks.description: client/src/pages/WorkloadPage.tsx: sprint or date-range scope, project and sprint selects, the capacity input with its validation message, and WorkloadList rows with the capacity bar and the tasks behind them.

tasks.title: Unit tests for the planning helpers
tasks.description: Jest suites for capacity, roadmap, workload, sprintReport, burndown and sprintStats in the two feature __tests__ folders, plus the navigation and report-link tests.
